title: A walk that fails is never parked on a task waiting for an answer
goal: The check between tasks found path-outline-align-walk failing and wrote it onto the task that owns the walk, but that task is waiting on one of the user's cards, so nobody will look at the failure until the card is answered. Fix the walk, and make sure a failing walk whose owner is blocked lands where a runner will pick it up.
